A whole unit and a damaged unit with no buff and no freeze should then both wear nothing (no `.cf-art-wear` element), and `wear` should be built only from buffed or frozen. This is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): nothing in the engine, `PlayerView` or the log changes.
